sections.title: Overview
sections.body:
An agent execution is not a single LLM request. It can contain a hierarchy of decisions, subagents, tool invocations, approval pauses, retries and external transactions.

- An agent execution is not a single LLM request.
- It can contain a hierarchy of decisions, subagents, tool invocations, approval pauses, retries and external transactions.
- 23.1 Complete agent trace Example agent execution 4.8 seconds Verified success Illustrative trace.
- Specialist agents execute concurrently and return results to the coordinator.
- 23.2 Trace hierarchy Useful telemetry includes agent and model versions, tool names, sanitized operation identifiers, duration, retries, token usage, decision categories, approval status and verified outcomes.

sections.title: 23.4 OpenTelemetry implementation
sections.body:
```python
from opentelemetry import trace
from opentelemetry.trace import Status, StatusCode

tracer = trace.get_tracer(
    "enterprise.agents"
)

def traced_tool_call(
    tool_name,
    execute
):

    with tracer.start_as_current_span(
        "agent.tool.execute"
    ) as span:

        span.set_attribute(
            "agent.tool.name",
            tool_name
        )

        try:

            result = execute()

            span.set_attribute(
                "agent.tool.outcome",
                "returned"
            )

            return result

        except Exception as exc:

            span.set_attribute(
                "error.type",
                type(exc).__name__
            )

            span.set_status(
                Status(StatusCode.ERROR)
            )

            raise
```

Configure the tracer provider, exporter and secure collector separately.

The status `returned` deliberately does not mean that the requested business operation succeeded. That must be verified independently.

sections.body:
Possible explanations include tool responses containing business-level errors, incorrect tool selection, missing required milestones, stale data, false completion and output verification regressions.

A health dashboard based only on HTTP status codes cannot diagnose these failures.

Monitor task outcomes separately from transport-level availability.
